data.exact_reserve_text: Losses continue to develop both positively and negatively on these open balances. Whilst the syndicate has a reasonable degree of confidence as to the ultimate adequacy of its recourse for all events, volatility exists around the final settlement value.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 59.820m. The report does not disclose a single explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure; the technical reserves note shows aggregate 'change in claims outstanding' (which includes current year movements) and the P&L shows a 'claims incurred - development of prior accident years' line (claims incurred, not a reserve movement). Consequently no authoritative gross prior-year reserve release/strengthening amount can be extracted from the disclosed notes. The syndicate states that losses continue to develop both positively and negatively and that volatility exists around final settlements.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred - development of prior accident years
The syndicate has loss reserves for various events and for losses that are incurred but not reported (IBNR).
Losses continue to develop both positively and negatively on these open balances.
Whilst the syndicate has a reasonable degree of confidence as to the ultimate adequacy of its recourse for all events, volatility exists around the final settlement value.
2014 calendar year as a relatively benign year for claims activity
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) is disclosed separately in the notes. The technical provisions note provides 'Change in claims outstanding' (gross = GBP 14,129k) which mixes current-year and prior-year movements; the Profit & Loss note shows 'Claims incurred - development of prior accident years' (gross = -GBP 4,000k) but that line is claims incurred, not a reserves movement. No gross claims development triangle is provided. Therefore a reliable GROSS prior year reserve movement cannot be calculated from the disclosed information. Amounts in the accounts are presented in GBP '000; opening reserves converted to millions for this output. If a gross prior-year movement is required, the only available gross figure in the technical reserves is the total change in claims outstanding (gross: 14,129k) but this includes current year movements and was therefore not used as the prior-year development figure.
